description: Accepted high-severity static findings. Every entry requires a review reason.

accepted.reason: One consolidated authority pass must inspect connected players for the existing request-variable contract; object requests use registries and this replaces two separate player scans.
Legacy state cleanup is once per player and zone identifiers are change-gated; remaining matches include user-triggered action closures lexically nested in the guarded bridge.
The one-second exclusive-lock watchdog emits exactly one terminal abandonment result on disconnect, death, or expiry, then exits.
The local display-loss watchdog emits exactly one abandonment result after its resolved flag check, then exits and clears its token state.

The loop is author-bounded to 256 node transitions and 16 lines per node; execution is event-paced by line duration or player choice, and sends presentation only to the current speaker owner or nearby audience.
Dynamic audience and disconnect checks are required at each authored line or choice boundary; the loop is session-local, duration-paced and hard-capped at 256 node transitions.
The five-second server prune loop broadcasts the tracker registry only when one or more tracked targets have become invalid, so idle passes do not publish state.
The server broadcasts UAV jamming state only on entry and exit transitions; the two-second scan does not republish unchanged drone state.
Attributed third-party player-marker code is disabled by default and intentionally left unmodified; review separately before enabling.
Attributed third-party player-marker code is disabled by default and intentionally left unmodified; review separately before enabling.

The two-second server monitor now change-gates all three typed availability booleans (helicopter/ground/boat) against their last broadcast value and only publishes one that actually flipped; the scanner still matches the setVariable[...,true] call sites textually inside the recurring loop even though each is behind an isNil-or-changed guard. Transport Services is enabled by default, so before this gating these three booleans were being re-broadcast to every connected client unconditionally every 2 seconds for the whole mission regardless of whether availability ever changed - the highest-volume unconditional broadcast found in the pack's own review for large player counts.
